c: Boil salted water; drop the flour in as one mound; pierce with a spoon handle; simmer 20 min covered.
Pour off and reserve some water; break the mound with a fork into crumbs, adding water back until fluffy.
Fry cracklings in lard; pour hot over the žganci; toss.
Serve with sauerkraut, jota or a glass of cold sour milk.

c: Roast peppers and aubergines whole on charcoal or 250 °C until blackened; steam in a covered bowl 20 min.
Peel, deseed, drain overnight in a colander (key for thickness).
Mince coarsely; cook in a wide pan with oil added gradually, stirring, 1 h 30 min until thick and glossy.
Add garlic, vinegar, sugar, salt in the last 10 min; hot-fill sterilised jars.
5739af56.st: Jars: cool and dark 6 months; opened 0–5 °C 2 weeks.

c: Simmer chicken 1 h 15 min; strain; pick meat.
Sweat diced carrot, celery and onion in butter; add flour; whisk in broth; add okra (trimmed whole); simmer 15 min.
Return meat; temper yolks, sour cream and lemon with hot broth; stir in off the boil (do not reboil).
cc3c50e4.st: Serve ≥ 63 °C. Cook-chill: 0–3 °C 72 h; reheat to ≥ 75 °C once.

c: Bake two puff sheets docked, weighted, 200 °C 20 min; cut one into 12 squares (top).
Boil milk with vanilla; whisk yolks, 200 g sugar, starch; cook to a thick custard 2 min.
Whip whites with 100 g sugar to soft peaks; fold into the hot custard; pour 5 cm over the base sheet.
Chill 4 h; top with whipped cream and the cut squares; dust icing sugar; cut along squares.
dfa0c59e.al: 1 Gluten (puff pastry) · 3 Eggs (egg yolks, egg whites) · 7 Milk (puff pastry, milk 3%, cream 35%). Contains gluten, eggs, milk.

c: Cut meats into 4 cm cubes; vegetables into large pieces.
Layer meats and vegetables in a deep pot with garlic, parsley, peppercorns, bay and salt.
Add water to three quarters height; cover with parchment and lid; simmer very low 3 h (or 150 °C oven).
Serve in the pot with somun bread.
425503c9.st: Serve ≥ 63 °C. Cook-chill: 0–3 °C 72 h; reheat to ≥ 75 °C once.
425503c9.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Allergen-free.

c: do not stir: shake the pot
Cut fish into 120 g pieces on the bone; salt 20 min.
Sweat onion and garlic in oil; add tomatoes, wine, vinegar, bay and water; simmer 15 min.
Lay fish in one layer; cover; cook 15–20 min, shaking the pot, never stirring.
Finish with parsley and raw olive oil.
Rain polenta into boiling salted water; cook 40 min stirring; finish with oil.
e6afbca6.st: Cook to order; fish 0–2 °C on ice, use within 24 h.

c: Knead 10 min; divide in 4; oil heavily; rest 1 h.
Stretch each over a floured table to paper-thin.
Mix raw mince with finely chopped onion, salt, pepper and water.
Lay a line of filling along the dough edge; roll into a long sausage; coil into an oiled round tin.
Brush with oil; bake 220 °C 35–40 min; sprinkle with water, cover with a cloth 10 min; serve with yoghurt.
Simmer carcasses and breast with vegetables 1 h; strain; shred breast.
Whisk sour cream, yolks and crushed garlic; temper with hot broth; stir back off the boil.
Sharpen with vinegar to taste; add chicken and chopped lovage.
Serve with fresh chilli and bread.
99086fbf.st: Serve ≥ 63 °C. Cook-chill: 0–3 °C 72 h; reheat to ≥ 75 °C once.
99086fbf.al: 3 Eggs (egg yolks) · 7 Milk (sour cream 20%) · 9 Celery (celeriac, lovage). Contains eggs, milk, celery.

c: Make a sponge of yeast, warm milk, a little sugar and flour; 20 min.
Beat yolks, eggs and sugar; add with flour, zests, vanilla, rum and salt; knead 15 min, adding melted butter and oil gradually.
Whip whites with sugar; fold in walnuts, cocoa and warm milk.
Divide dough into 4; roll each 40 × 30 cm; spread filling; roll up; twist two together per tin.
Prove 1 h; egg-wash; bake 170 °C 50 min (cover after 20 min); cool in tins 15 min.
ba36f87f.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (egg yolks, eggs, egg whites) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter) · 8 Nuts (walnuts). Contains gluten, eggs, milk, nuts (walnuts).

c: Cut cuttlefish in 1.5 cm strips; sweat onion and garlic in oil; add cuttlefish; stew covered 25 min until tender.
Add rice; toast 2 min; deglaze wine; stir in tomato paste and ink.
Add hot stock gradually 17–18 min; finish all'onda with butter and parsley.
Serve with lemon wedge; no cheese (Dalmatian tradition).
ec0de1cc.st: Cook to order; fish 0–2 °C on ice, use within 24 h.
ec0de1cc.al: 4 Fish (fish stock) · 7 Milk (butter) · 12 Molluscs (cuttlefish, squid ink) · 14 Sulphites (white wine). Contains molluscs, fish (stock), milk, sulphites.

c: Debeard mussels; discard open ones that do not close when tapped.
Warm oil and garlic; add mussels and wine; cover; cook 4 min shaking.
Discard any closed; sprinkle breadcrumbs and parsley to thicken the juices; toss.
Serve in deep bowls with bread and lemon.
200bfee7.st: Cook to order; fish 0–2 °C on ice, use within 24 h.
200bfee7.al: 1 Gluten (breadcrumbs) · 12 Molluscs (mussels) · 14 Sulphites (white wine). Contains molluscs, gluten, sulphites.

c: Soak raisins in rum. Mix a soft batter-dough with all except oil and sugar; beat 5 min.
Drop walnut-sized balls with a wet spoon into oil 170 °C; fry 3 min until golden; drain.
Dust with icing sugar; serve warm.
cf082558.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (milk 3%). Contains gluten, eggs, milk; sulphites (raisins).

c: Knead dough; rest 30 min. Boil and mash potatoes; mix with fried lardons, onion, chives, marjoram.
Roll dough 1 mm; dot hazelnut-sized filling; fold over; press between with a finger to make the 'hat' shape; cut.
Dice lamb 1 cm; brown; add onion and carrot; tomato paste; deglaze wine.
Add stock and rosemary; simmer 1 h 30 min until saucy; finish with butter; spoon over žlikrofi.
9d729004.st: Serve ≥ 63 °C. Cook-chill: 0–3 °C 72 h; reheat to ≥ 75 °C once.
9d729004.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (butter) · 9 Celery (veal stock) · 14 Sulphites (white wine). Contains gluten, eggs, milk, sulphites; celery if in the stock.

c: quills: 4 cm diamonds rolled on a stick
Knead to a firm dough 10 min; rest 30 min.
Roll 1.5 mm; cut 4 cm diamonds; roll each on a thin stick corner to corner; dry 20 min.
Melt butter; add cream and paste; reduce by one third.
Cook fuži 3–4 min; toss with sauce and Parmesan; shave fresh truffle over.
4f582ac5.st: Fresh pasta 0–3 °C 24 h; sauce to order.
4f582ac5.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour 00) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (butter, cream 35%, parmesan). Contains gluten, eggs, milk.

c: Simmer ribs with bay in water 1 h; remove meat from bones.
Cook sauerkraut in some of the broth 30 min; cook diced potatoes separately and mash half.
Combine beans, kraut, potatoes and broth; make a light roux of lard, flour, garlic, paprika; whisk in.
Simmer 20 min; return meat; rest overnight for best flavour.
1be708b3.st: Serve ≥ 63 °C. Cook-chill: 0–3 °C 72 h; reheat to ≥ 75 °C once.

c: Spread 40 g chilled kajmak along one edge; roll tightly, tuck ends; chill 30 min.
Flour, egg, crumb twice (seals the kajmak).
Deep-fry 165 °C 8–9 min to core 70 °C; drain; serve with tartare sauce, lemon and fries.
Chop gherkins, capers, parsley fine; fold into mayonnaise with lemon.
7af757d2.st: Serve ≥ 63 °C. Cook-chill: 0–3 °C 72 h; reheat to ≥ 75 °C once.
7af757d2.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, breadcrumbs) · 3 Eggs (eggs, mayonnaise) · 7 Milk (kajmak). Contains gluten, eggs, milk, mustard (mayonnaise).

c: Render lardons; sweat onion; add sauerkraut, caraway, bay, water; braise 40 min.
Heat sausages in water at 80 °C 20 min — never boil (casing bursts).
Serve one 180 g sausage on kraut with mustard and fresh horseradish.
c997f2ba.st: Serve ≥ 63 °C. Cook-chill: 0–3 °C 72 h; reheat to ≥ 75 °C once.
c997f2ba.al: 10 Mustard (wholegrain mustard). Contains mustard; sausages may contain milk and soy (check label).

c: Cut lamb into 200 g pieces; season; brown in butter.
Layer with sliced potatoes in a deep tray; add garlic, rosemary, bay; pour milk to cover by two thirds.
Bake covered 160 °C 2 h; uncover 30 min at 200 °C until the milk turns golden and curdy.
8cfbd152.st: Serve ≥ 63 °C. Cook-chill: 0–3 °C 72 h; reheat to ≥ 75 °C once.

c: traditional: embers on an iron bell; here 160 °C covered
Cut lamb into 200 g bone-in pieces; season; rub with garlic, rosemary, oil.
Layer potatoes (quartered) and onion in a heavy roasting pan; lamb on top; wine over.
Uncover; baste; 220 °C 25 min until crisp; rest 10 min.
a69ac082.st: Serve ≥ 63 °C. Cook-chill: 0–3 °C 72 h; reheat to ≥ 75 °C once.

c: Mince beef, lamb and fat through a 3 mm plate twice.
Dissolve soda in cold stock; add with garlic and spices; knead 10 min until sticky.
Rest 12 h at 2 °C (soda makes them springy).
Shape 10 cm logs with wet hands; grill 8–10 min turning to core 72 °C; serve with mustard, bread and fries.
1c4ea894.st: Raw mix 0–3 °C 24 h; grill to order.
1c4ea894.al: 9 Celery (beef stock). Contains celery if in the stock; mustard with service.

c: Mix quark, eggs, sugar, zest, vanilla, soda and salt; work in flour to a soft dough.
Shape 100 g rings and 30 g balls with floured hands.
Fry 160 °C 4–5 min per side until deep golden and cooked through.
Ring on the plate, sour cream inside, jam over, ball on top; dust icing sugar.
923b83b0.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (quark, sour cream 20%). Contains gluten, eggs, milk.

c: Lard the beef with pancetta and garlic slivers; marinate in vinegar 24 h, turning.
Dry; sear hard all over; remove. Sweat onion, carrot, celeriac until deep golden 20 min.
Add tomato paste, prunes, cloves, bay; deglaze wine and Prošek; return beef; add stock to half height.
Braise covered 160 °C 3 h until tender; rest, slice 1 cm.
Blend the sauce smooth; reduce to coating; adjust sweet–sour with vinegar.
Boil gnocchi until they float + 30 s; toss in butter and some sauce; Parmesan over.
3956fbaa.st: Serve ≥ 63 °C. Cook-chill: 0–3 °C 72 h; reheat to ≥ 75 °C once.
3956fbaa.al: 1 Gluten (potato gnocchi) · 7 Milk (butter, parmesan) · 9 Celery (celeriac, beef stock) · 14 Sulphites (red wine vinegar, red wine, prošek). Contains gluten, eggs (gnocchi), milk, celery, sulphites.

c: Knead 10 min; prove 1 h; divide into 160 g pieces.
Roll ovals 30 cm; fold in edges and pinch ends into boats.
Fill each boat with 100 g diced pastrma; bake 250 °C 10 min.
Crack an egg on top; bake 3 more min; brush edges with butter; serve with pickled chillies.
dd036b5e.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (butter). Contains gluten, eggs, milk.

c: Mix minces with grated onion, garlic, salt, pepper, paprika, soda and sparkling water; knead 5 min; rest 12 h at 2 °C.
Press 200 g balls flat between film to 1 cm, 22 cm across.
Grill on a very hot plancha or charcoal 3–4 min per side to core 72 °C.
Warm lepinja on the grill; split.
Fill with pljeskavica, a spoon of kajmak, ajvar and chopped raw onion.
6cb6e8e6.st: Raw mix 0–3 °C 24 h; grill to order.

c: Soak beans 12 h; cook with bay until tender but whole 1 h; drain, keep 600 ml liquor.
Cook sliced onions slowly in oil 30 min until soft and golden; add garlic and paprika off heat.
Layer beans and onions in a clay dish; add liquor; bake 180 °C 1 h until a crust forms.
2946a7ae.st: Serve ≥ 63 °C. Cook-chill: 0–3 °C 72 h; reheat to ≥ 75 °C once.
2946a7ae.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan. Allergen-free.

c: Line the tray with rolled puff pastry (base).
Prepare 4 fillings: poppy + sugar; quark + egg + sugar + vanilla; grated apple + cinnamon + sugar; walnut + sugar.
Layer: filo (brushed with butter), poppy, filo, quark, filo, walnut, filo, apple — repeat once; finish with filo.
Pour cream–sour cream–egg mix over; bake 180 °C 60–70 min; cool before cutting.
2c0d41ce.st: Best on the day; 0–5 °C 48 h. Ambient 24 h.
2c0d41ce.al: 1 Gluten (puff pastry, filo pastry) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (puff pastry, quark, sour cream 20%, cream 35%, butter) · 8 Nuts (walnuts). Contains gluten, eggs, milk, nuts (walnuts).

c: Mix dry; whisk eggs, yoghurt, water, oil; combine.
Fold in crumbled cheese and kajmak; pour into an oiled hot tray.
Bake 200 °C 30–35 min until golden; rest 10 min; cut.
e15882f7.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (yoghurt 3.6%, feta, kajmak). Contains gluten, eggs, milk.

c: Caramelise 200 g sugar with water to amber; pour into ramekins.
Infuse milk with vanilla and zest; cool to 60 °C; whisk into eggs and remaining sugar; add rose water; strain.
Fill; bake in a bain-marie 150 °C 40–45 min until just set.
Desalt leaves in cold water 1 h if very sour; cut out thick ribs.
Sweat onion; mix with minces, washed rice, paprika, dill, thyme, pepper, little salt.
Roll 60 g filling tightly in each leaf; layer in a pot over shredded kraut and ribs; add bay.
Pour passata and water to cover; bake covered 160 °C 3 h.
Cook polenta 30 min to a firm mămăligă; finish with butter.
Plate 4 sarmale, a slice of mămăligă, sour cream and a fresh chilli.
4a503307.st: Serve ≥ 63 °C. Cook-chill: 0–3 °C 72 h; reheat to ≥ 75 °C once.

c: Cut pork shoulder into 80 g pieces; ribs and hock into pieces.
Layer shredded cabbage, sauerkraut and meats in a clay pot or deep roaster with bay, pepper, paprika; add water.
Cover; bake 150 °C 4 h; do not stir.
Rest 20 min; serve with bread and fresh chilli.
59ecc2ce.st: Serve ≥ 63 °C. Cook-chill: 0–3 °C 72 h; reheat to ≥ 75 °C once.
59ecc2ce.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Allergen-free (check smoked products).

c: Cut pork 2 cm; render belly in lard; brown shoulder in batches.
Add sliced sausage, garlic, paprika; deglaze wine; add passata and thyme.
Cook mămăligă 30 min; fry eggs sunny side up.
Plate stew beside mămăligă topped with grated telemea and a fried egg.
a34f304c.st: Serve ≥ 63 °C. Cook-chill: 0–3 °C 72 h; reheat to ≥ 75 °C once.
a34f304c.al: 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (telemea) · 14 Sulphites (white wine). Contains eggs, milk, sulphites.

c: Peel and core apples (wide hollow); boil sugar, water and lemon; poach apples 8–10 min until just tender; cool in syrup.
Mix walnuts with 100 ml syrup; fill the hollows generously.
Reduce the syrup by half; spoon over; chill 2 h.
Crumble cheese; mash with kajmak and sour cream.
Fold in minced chilli, garlic, paprika bloomed in warm oil.
Rest 2 h; serve with lepinja and grilled meats.
814b2d07.al: 7 Milk (feta, kajmak, sour cream 20%). Contains milk.

c: Roast aubergines and peppers until blackened; peel; drain 2 h; chop fine.
Cook diced onion slowly in oil 20 min; add peppers and tomato paste; cook 20 min.
Add aubergine and bay; cook on low 1 h, stirring, until thick; season.
Hot-fill sterilised jars, or chill for use within a week.
a87e5645.st: Jars: cool and dark 6 months; opened 0–5 °C 1 week.
a87e5645.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan. Allergen-free.

c: Knead soft dough 10 min; oil; rest 1 h warm.
Stretch on a floured cloth to transparent (1 × 1.5 m).
Mix quark, sour cream, eggs, salt; spread over two thirds of the dough.
Roll up with the cloth; cut 8 cm pieces with a plate edge; lay in a buttered dish.
Pour cream over; dot butter; bake 200 °C 30–35 min until blistered and golden.
e30a19d6.st: Serve ≥ 63 °C. Cook-chill: 0–3 °C 72 h; reheat to ≥ 75 °C once.
e30a19d6.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (quark, sour cream 20%, cream 35%, butter). Contains gluten, eggs, milk.

c: Dissolve soda in the yoghurt (it foams); whisk in eggs and sparkling water.
Crumble the sirene finely and stir in; do not salt (sirene is salty).
Mix melted butter and oil. Lay 2 filo sheets, brush, sprinkle filling; repeat, or crumple sheets loosely into the GN.
Pour remaining filling evenly over the top; brush the surface with fat.
Rest 15 min; bake 180 °C convection 40–45 min until deep golden and set (core ≥ 75 °C).
Sprinkle a little water and cover with a cloth 10 min (soft top); cut 20 pieces.
66bfbab3.st: 0–4 °C, 48 h; reheat 160 °C 8 min. Room temp. max 2 h.
66bfbab3.al: 1 Gluten (filo pastry) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (sirene, yoghurt 3.6%, butter)

c: Soak beans 12 h; drain; cover with fresh water; boil 10 min; drain; simmer in 2.5 L with bay 1 h until just tender.
Sweat onion, carrot and pepper in oil 10 min; add paprika and flour 1 min; add tomatoes 5 min.
Combine with beans and their liquid (beans just covered); add mint, savory, chilli and salt.
Divide into clay pots; bake 180 °C 40–45 min until thick with a light crust; core ≥ 75 °C.
Finish with parsley; serve with pickles and bread.
Sweat diced onion in oil 6 min; add paprika and rinsed rice; stir 2 min; cool.
Mix with mince, savory, pepper and salt (sauerkraut adds salt).
Separate the leaves; rinse if very salty; cut out thick ribs; chop small leaves for lining.
Place 50 g filling on each leaf; roll tight, tucking the sides.
Line the pot with chopped leaves and lardons; pack sarmi seam down in layers; add bay.
Mix water and tomato paste; pour to just cover; weigh down with a plate.
Simmer covered 1 h 30 min on low (or 160 °C oven 2 h); core ≥ 75 °C. Serve with yoghurt.
3cbf2bfe.st: 0–4 °C, 3 days; reheat in their liquid, core ≥ 75 °C.

c: ≈ 3.8 kg · clay pot or GN with lid
Cut beef into 4 cm pieces; brown in oil in batches.
Add paprika and tomato paste off the heat 1 min; deglaze with wine; reduce by half.
Layer in the pot: beef, whole pearl onions, carrot chunks, whole garlic cloves, bay, pepper and allspice; add water; season.
Seal the lid with dough or foil; bake 160 °C 2 h.
Add potato chunks; bake 45–50 min more until beef is very tender; core ≥ 75 °C; finish with parsley.
Roast peppers 220 °C 15–20 min until blistered; cover 10 min; peel, keep whole, remove seeds via the top.
Mix crumbled sirene, 2 eggs and parsley; fill each pepper with ≈ 30 g; close the opening.
Dust in flour, dip in beaten egg, coat in breadcrumbs.
Shallow-fry 170 °C 2–3 min per side until golden; core ≥ 75 °C.
Drain on paper; serve hot with yoghurt or plain.
6ddcaffe.st: Breaded raw 0–4 °C 24 h. Fried: serve within 1 h; reheat 180 °C 6 min.

c: Soak beans 12 h; boil 10 min, drain; simmer in fresh water 1 h until soft; drain (keep 400 ml liquid).
Sweat onion and carrot in oil 8 min; add paprika and flour 1 min; add beans, mint, savory, seasoning and a little liquid; mash lightly.
Soak dried peppers in hot water 30 min until soft; drain; keep the water.
Fill each pepper with ≈ 50 g filling; stand upright or lay in a GN.
Add 400 ml pepper water; drizzle oil; cover; bake 180 °C 30 min, uncover 10 min.
Blanch the offal 15 min in salted water; cool; dice 1 cm (keep the stock).
Sweat onion and spring onion in butter 6 min; add offal 3 min, then rice, paprika, mint and pepper; stir 2 min.
Transfer to a buttered GN; add 700 ml hot offal stock; cover; bake 180 °C 30 min until rice is just tender.
Whisk yoghurt, eggs and flour; pour over the rice.
Bake uncovered 180 °C 15–20 min until set and golden; core ≥ 75 °C; rest 10 min before cutting.
Cut zucchini on the bias 8 mm; salt; rest 15 min; pat very dry.
Dust in flour; shake off excess.
Shallow-fry 175 °C 2 min per side until golden; drain on paper.
Mix yoghurt, crushed garlic, dill, oil and salt.
Serve 60 g alongside or spooned over; sprinkle chopped walnuts (optional).
e967bc89.st: Fry to order or max 30 min ahead. Sauce 0–4 °C 48 h.
e967bc89.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 7 Milk (strained yoghurt) · 8 Nuts (walnuts). Walnuts optional: omit for nut allergy.

c: Sweat onion and carrot in oil 8 min; add garlic, then paprika off the heat (it burns easily).
Add tomato paste 2 min, then tomatoes, potatoes in 3 cm chunks, water, bay and savory.
Simmer covered 25 min until potatoes are soft and the sauce thick; season.

cc598ed9.yl: Yield: 1 round loaf Ø 30 cm ≈ 1.1 kg · 16 portions × 70 g
c: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water (35 °C); mix with flour, salt and oil; knead 10 min until smooth.
Keep 200 g for decoration; shape the rest into a round loaf on a lined tray; place a coin wrapped in foil inside (tradition).
Decorate with dough rolls: cross, sun, sheaf of wheat, or crook; brush with sugared water.
Bake 180 °C convection 35–40 min until deep golden and hollow-sounding; core 94 °C.
Cover with a cloth to cool (soft crust).
cc598ed9.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 11 Sesame (sesame seeds). Contains a foil-wrapped coin: warn guests when serving.

c: Cut lamb into 2 cm cubes; cover with cold water; bring to the boil; skim; simmer 1 h 15 min until tender; core ≥ 75 °C.
Sweat onion, carrot and pepper in oil 6 min; add paprika; add to the soup with rice and diced tomatoes.
Whisk yoghurt and eggs; temper with 300 ml hot broth; stir back in off the heat (do not boil again, ≤ 85 °C).
Finish with parsley, spearmint and vinegar to taste.
08cb2fd4.st: 0–4 °C, 48 h; reheat gently to 75 °C without boiling.

c: Roast peppers and eggplant 220 °C 25–30 min until charred; cover 15 min; peel and seed.
Blanch and peel tomatoes; mince all vegetables with the chilli (5 mm plate or pulse in a cutter).
Cook in a heavy pan on low, stirring often, 1 h 30 min until thick (spoon stands, no free water).
Add oil, sugar, salt and garlic in the last 20 min; vinegar at the end.
Fill sterilised jars hot (≥ 85 °C); close; pasteurise 20 min at 90 °C for long storage.
4895528e.st: Open/unsealed: 0–4 °C, 10 days. Pasteurised jars: cool, dark place 6 months; after opening 0–4 °C, 7 days.

c: Boil eggs 10 min; chill; peel; quarter.
Slice mushrooms; sauté in 20 g oil 4 min; season; cool.
Dice tomatoes and cucumbers 2 cm; strip peppers; slice onion thinly; julienne ham.
Dress vegetables with oil, vinegar and salt; plate; top with mushrooms and ham.
Finish with grated sirene and kashkaval, egg quarters, olives and parsley.
958db78b.st: Components 0–4 °C 24 h. Dress and assemble to order.
958db78b.al: 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (sirene, kashkaval) · 14 Sulphites (red wine vinegar)

244c7ea6.yl: Yield: 10 parlenki Ø 22 cm · Portion: 1 parlenka ≈ 140 g
c: Mix to a soft dough 8 min; prove 1 h until doubled.
Divide 100 g; round; rest 10 min; press out by hand to Ø 22 cm, 5 mm thick; dimple with fingers.
Bake on a very hot grill pan or stone 250 °C 3–4 min (2 min per side on the grill) until puffed and spotted.
Brush at once with garlic-parsley butter; sprinkle savory and finely grated sirene; serve hot, cut in 4.

a81cf3c0.yl: Yield: 1 pan Ø 32 cm or GN 1/2 · 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 160 g
c: Coarsely grate potatoes; salt; rest 15 min; squeeze out as much liquid as possible.
Mix with finely diced onion, eggs, crumbled sirene, spearmint and pepper.
Heat oil in a heavy pan (or GN); press the mix in 3–4 cm thick.
Cook on the stove on low 15 min to form a crust; then bake 190 °C convection 35–40 min until golden.
Turn out crust side up; cut into 10; core ≥ 75 °C.

ce3dcabb.yl: Yield: 1 GN 1/1 · 10 portions × 380 g (1 leg + rice)
c: Season legs with salt, paprika, pepper and oil.
Sweat diced onion and carrot in butter 5 min; add rice and paprika, fry 2 min.
Spread in GN, pour over hot stock (1 : 2.3), add savory and bay.
Place chicken on top; cover with foil; bake 180 °C 30 min; uncover 15 min until rice is dry and skin crisp.
Core chicken ≥ 75 °C; rest 10 min; finish with parsley.
ce3dcabb.al: 7 Milk (butter) · 9 Celery (chicken stock). Chicken stock: check label.

c: Sweat finely diced onion and grated carrot in oil 8 min; add rice and paprika, stir 3 min.
Add 150 ml water; cook 5 min until absorbed; off heat add herbs and seasoning; cool.
Blanch leaves 1 min; rinse; trim stems.
Roll 18 g filling per leaf, tight and small (pencil thickness).
Pack seam down in a leaf-lined pot; add water, lemon and oil; weigh down with a plate.
Simmer covered 50–60 min until rice is soft; cool in the liquid. Serve warm or cold with lemon.
9722180e.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan, no dairy, no eggs (lenten). Check jar label of vine leaves for sulphites.

c: Wash leeks thoroughly; cut in 2 cm rings (white and light green).
Sweat leeks in oil 10 min until soft; add tomato paste and paprika 1 min.
Add rinsed rice and hot water; season; cover and cook on low 18–20 min (or 180 °C oven 25 min).
Rest 10 min; finish with lemon, parsley and olives. Serve warm or at room temperature.
6ab4259c.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan (lenten).

c: Butter each pot; layer 120 g crumbled sirene, 80 g diced tomato and 50 g roasted pepper strips.
Add a slice of chilli and 0.5 g paprika; top with a knob of butter.
Cover with lid; bake 200 °C 15 min until bubbling.

afcf4829.st: Milk ≥ 63 °C in a bain-marie max 2 h. Sweet version: replace sirene with 20 g honey or sugar.
afcf4829.al: 1 Gluten (bread, white, stale) · 7 Milk (milk 3.6%, butter, sirene). Contains gluten, milk.

c: Whisk eggs, milk and sugar; whisk in flour and salt until smooth; add water and oil. Rest 1 h at 0–4 °C.
Cook in a large hot pan or on a griddle 220 °C, very thin, 40 s per side.
Three katmi folded in quarters, 30 g honey and 15 g chopped walnuts; or 50 g crumbled sirene for a savoury version.
030861f4.st: Batter 0–4 °C 24 h. Cooked katmi covered at room temperature 2 h or 0–4 °C 48 h; reheat on the griddle.
030861f4.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (milk 3.6%) · 8 Nuts (walnuts). Contains gluten, eggs, milk, nuts.

c: Mix mince with grated onion, egg, spices, salt and parsley; chill 30 min.
Spread 40 g mince evenly to the edges of each slice (it shrinks).
Bake on a tray 200 °C 10 min until the mince is cooked (core ≥ 75 °C); top with 15 g kashkaval; bake 3 min more.
Two printsesi per portion with pickles or tomato.
091b00e6.st: Raw spread toasts 0–4 °C 12 h. Bake to order.
091b00e6.al: 1 Gluten (bread, white, sliced) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (kashkaval, grated). Contains gluten, eggs, milk.

c: GN 1/2 or Ø 30 cm round tin
Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm milk (35 °C); mix with yoghurt, egg and oil; knead with flour and salt 8 min to a soft dough. Prove 1 h at 26 °C.
Roll dough 5 mm; spread with melted butter, sirene and beaten egg; roll up, cut into 12 rounds; set in the tin.
Prove 30 min; brush with egg; bake 180 °C 35 min until core ≥ 92 °C and deep golden. Brush with butter.
2bd79ed3.st: Ambient covered 24 h; reheat 160 °C 5 min. Freezes baked −18 °C 1 month.
2bd79ed3.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (yoghurt 3.6%, milk 3.6%, sirene, butter). Contains gluten, eggs, milk.

c: Blanch spinach 30 s, refresh, squeeze very dry, chop. Sweat sliced leek and spring onion in a little oil 5 min; cool.
Mix greens with crumbled sirene, eggs, yoghurt, dill and pepper.
Brush a GN 1/1 × 65 mm; layer 2 sheets of filo brushed with butter-oil, a thin layer of filling; repeat; finish with 3 brushed sheets.
Pre-cut into 20 portions; bake 180 °C 45 min until golden; core ≥ 75 °C. Sprinkle water, cover 10 min.
78de16fe.st: Room temperature max 4 h; 0–4 °C 72 h; reheat 160 °C 8 min. Freezes raw −18 °C 2 months (bake from frozen +15 min).
78de16fe.al: 1 Gluten (filo pastry) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (sirene, yoghurt 3.6%, butter). Contains gluten, eggs, milk.

c: Cook rice in milk 12 min (half-cooked); cool; mix with crumbled sirene, eggs, melted butter and pepper.
Line a round 40 cm tin or GN 1/1 with 4 oiled sheets overhanging; layer filling and loosely ruffled sheets; fold over the overhang.
Bake 180 °C 50 min until golden and the centre is set (core ≥ 75 °C). Brush with butter; rest 15 min before cutting.
7b7364ad.st: Room temperature max 4 h; 0–4 °C 72 h; reheat 160 °C 8 min.
7b7364ad.al: 1 Gluten (filo pastry) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (milk 3.6%, sirene, butter). Contains gluten, eggs, milk.

c: Cut potatoes into 3 cm wedges; parboil 5 min in salted water; drain and let steam off 5 min (rough edges crisp better).
Toss with oil, savory, paprika, salt and pepper; spread one layer on a hot GN; roast 210 °C convection 30–35 min, turning once.
Last 5 min add crushed garlic; finish with parsley.
24af9da2.st: Hold ≥ 63 °C uncovered max 45 min. Not suitable for cook-chill.

c: Sweat onion and pepper in oil 6 min; add bulgur and toast 2 min; add paste, tomatoes and hot stock.
Cover; cook on low heat 15 min; rest covered off the heat 10 min. Fluff with a fork; add mint.
3186d009.st: Hold ≥ 63 °C max 2 h. Cool ≤ 5 °C within 90 min; 0–3 °C 48 h; reheat once to ≥ 75 °C.
3186d009.al: 1 Gluten (bulgur, coarse) · 9 Celery (vegetable stock). Contains gluten, celery.

c: 5 discs Ø 24 cm on baking paper
Whip whites to soft peaks; add sugar in 3 additions to a stiff glossy meringue.
Fold in finely ground walnuts mixed with flour by hand.
Spread 5 thin discs; bake 160 °C 15–18 min until light golden; cool on the paper.
Bring cream to 85 °C; pour over chopped chocolate; rest 1 min; emulsify from the centre; add soft butter at 40 °C.
Layer discs and ganache (≈ 120 g between layers); coat top and sides; decorate with walnut halves.
Set at 0–4 °C 6 h before cutting with a hot knife into 16 portions.
9ecef1e6.st: 0–4 °C 4 days covered. Freezes −18 °C 1 month (thaw 12 h at 0–4 °C).
9ecef1e6.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (egg whites) · 7 Milk (double cream, dark chocolate 55%, butter) · 8 Nuts (walnuts, ground, walnuts, halves). Contains gluten, eggs, milk, nuts.

c: Make first; must be cold when the dough is hot
Boil sugar, water and lemon zest strips 8 min; add juice; cool completely.
Boil water, butter and salt; add flour at once and cook 2 min stirring until a film forms on the pan.
Cool 5 min; beat in eggs one by one to a smooth piping consistency.
Pipe 6 cm fingers through a 12 mm star tip into oil at 160 °C (start cooler for a hollow centre); fry 6–8 min turning, until deep golden and dry.
Drop hot tolumbichki into the cold syrup 3–4 min; lift and drain.
9e1f6d57.st: Ambient covered 24 h; 0–4 °C 72 h. Syrup ambient 7 days.
9e1f6d57.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (butter). Contains gluten, eggs, milk.

c: Cook sugar and water to a deep amber (180 °C); pour 25 g into each 150 ml ramekin; let set.
Scald milk with the scraped vanilla to 85 °C; pour onto eggs, yolks and sugar whisked together (no foam). Strain; rest 10 min; skim.
Fill ramekins; bake in a 50 °C water bath at 150 °C 40–45 min until set with a slight wobble (core 80 °C).
Cool; chill at least 6 h at 0–4 °C. Unmould with a knife around the edge onto a plate with a rim.
b7b977e9.al: 3 Eggs (eggs, egg yolks) · 7 Milk (milk 3.6%). Contains eggs, milk.

c: Simmer washed rice in water 10 min until absorbed.
Add milk, vanilla and salt; simmer gently 35–40 min, stirring, until creamy. Add sugar and butter for the last 5 min (sugar early catches).
Portion 180 g into bowls; dust with cinnamon. Serve warm, or chill to ≤ 5 °C within 90 min.
c1f97df5.st: 0–4 °C 72 h, covered with film on the surface.

c: Chop walnuts medium-fine; mix with sugar and cinnamon.
Layer 10 filo sheets each brushed with clarified butter; scatter one third of the nuts; repeat 3 times; finish with 10 brushed sheets.
Chill 20 min; cut through into diamonds; bake 160 °C 60–70 min until deep golden and crisp.
Boil sugar and water 10 min; add honey and lemon; cool to room temperature.
Pour cold syrup over the hot baklava along the cuts. Rest 8 h before serving.
7aa28fd7.st: Ambient, covered, 7 days. Do not refrigerate (filo softens).
7aa28fd7.al: 1 Gluten (filo pastry) · 7 Milk (butter, clarified) · 8 Nuts (walnuts). Contains gluten, milk, nuts.

c: Whisk eggs and sugar 5 min to ribbon; add yoghurt, oil and lemon zest.
Fold in semolina, flour and baking powder; rest 15 min. Bake 175 °C 35 min until a skewer comes out clean.
Boil sugar and water 6 min; add juice; cool. Pour the cool syrup over the hot cake; rest 3 h; cut 20 pieces.
aeeaa41f.al: 1 Gluten (semolina, fine, wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (yoghurt 3.6%). Contains gluten, eggs, milk.

c: Tease kataifi strands apart; toss with melted clarified butter.
Press half into the tray, spread walnuts mixed with sugar and cinnamon, cover with the rest, press firmly.
Boil 8 min, add juice, cool. Pour over the hot kadaif; rest 4 h; cut 20 squares.
f58b45a7.al: 1 Gluten (kataifi pastry) · 7 Milk (butter, clarified) · 8 Nuts (walnuts). Contains gluten, milk, nuts.

c: Blend all to a smooth batter; rest 1 h at 0–4 °C.
Cook thin crêpes in a hot lightly oiled pan 40 s per side; stack.
Compote: simmer cherries and sugar 5 min; thicken with cornflour slaked in water; cool.
Per portion: 3 crêpes folded in quarters, 25 g honey, 20 g toasted walnuts, 60 g compote.
f38aaa61.st: Crêpes 0–4 °C 72 h, interleaved; reheat on a griddle. Compote 0–4 °C 5 days.
f38aaa61.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (milk 3.6%) · 8 Nuts (walnuts). Contains gluten, eggs, milk, nuts.

c: Cut pumpkin into 6 × 8 cm pieces with the skin; seed.
Arrange skin-down in a GN with the water; sprinkle with sugar; bake 180 °C 45–60 min until soft and caramelised at the edges.
Serve warm with honey, chopped toasted walnuts and cinnamon.
f10ca672.st: 0–4 °C 72 h; serve cold or reheat 160 °C 8 min.

c: Start 3 days ahead · keep the starter from the last batch
Toast flours in a dry pan to light beige; whisk into 4 L cold water; cook 30 min, stirring, to a thin porridge.
Add 1 L cold water; cool to 30 °C. Strain through a fine sieve.
Stir in the sugar and the starter; ferment covered at 24–26 °C for 24–36 h until slightly sour and fizzy.
Chill at once to 0–4 °C to slow fermentation; keep 200 ml as the next starter.
bbfb40c9.st: 0–4 °C 5 days in closed containers (pressure builds; vent daily). Serve at 4–6 °C, stirred.
bbfb40c9.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, boza starter). Contains gluten.
